title: 单元 3
sourceNote: Headword order from 四级单词List1-35.xlsx; cards rewritten to gaozhong field standard.

words.meaning: adv. ①尤其，特别（particularly important / in）；②格外地。particular（特定的；挑剔的）；in particular（尤其）。语气强于 especially 的书面用法相近。
words.phrases: particularly important（尤其重要）, in particular（尤其）, be particular about（对…挑剔）
words.example: Air pollution is particularly harmful to children and the elderly.（空气污染对儿童和老年人尤其有害。）
words.root: particular（特定的）+ -ly → 就特定方面而言 → 尤其
words.exampleEn: Air pollution is particularly harmful to children and the elderly.
words.exampleZh: 空气污染对儿童和老年人尤其有害。
words.mnemonic: particular（特定的）+ -ly → 就特定方面而言 → 尤其
words.exampleEN: Air pollution is particularly harmful to children and the elderly.
words.exampleCN: 空气污染对儿童和老年人尤其有害。

words.meaning: n. ①节省，节约（a saving of）；②存款（savings，常用复数）。adj. 节约的。save（节省；拯救）。saving account 宜作 savings account。
words.phrases: savings account（储蓄账户）, a saving of（节省了…）, energy saving（节能）
words.example: Energy-saving measures led to a 15 per cent saving on electricity bills.（节能措施使电费节省了百分之十五。）
words.root: save（节省）+ -ing → 省下来的钱或行为
words.exampleEn: Energy-saving measures led to a 15 per cent saving on electricity bills.
words.exampleZh: 节能措施使电费节省了百分之十五。
words.mnemonic: save（节省）+ -ing → 省下来的钱或行为
words.exampleEN: Energy-saving measures led to a 15 per cent saving on electricity bills.
words.exampleCN: 节能措施使电费节省了百分之十五。

words.meaning: adj. ①古代的（ancient history / civilisation，英式 -isation）；②古老的。the ancients（古人）。反义 modern。比 old 更强调久远历史。
words.phrases: ancient history（古代史）, ancient civilisation（古代文明）, ancient times（古代）
words.example: The museum exhibition focuses on ancient civilisation in the Mediterranean.（该博物馆展览聚焦地中海地区的古代文明。）
words.root: ante（在前）同源 → 很久以前的
words.exampleEn: The museum exhibition focuses on ancient civilisation in the Mediterranean.
words.exampleZh: 该博物馆展览聚焦地中海地区的古代文明。
words.mnemonic: ante（在前）同源 → 很久以前的
words.exampleEN: The museum exhibition focuses on ancient civilisation in the Mediterranean.
words.exampleCN: 该博物馆展览聚焦地中海地区的古代文明。

words.meaning: n. 卡路里，热量单位（calorie intake；low-calorie）。复数 calories。calorie-controlled diet。与 energy 在营养学中常互换使用。
words.phrases: calorie intake（卡路里摄入）, low-calorie（低热量的）, empty calories（空热量）
words.example: Public health advice recommends reducing daily calorie intake.（公共卫生建议主张降低每日卡路里摄入。）
words.root: calor（热）+ -ie → 热量单位
words.exampleEn: Public health advice recommends reducing daily calorie intake.
words.exampleZh: 公共卫生建议主张降低每日卡路里摄入。
words.mnemonic: calor（热）+ -ie → 热量单位
words.exampleEN: Public health advice recommends reducing daily calorie intake.
words.exampleCN: 公共卫生建议主张降低每日卡路里摄入。

words.meaning: v. ①扩大，扩展（expand into / on）；②膨胀。expansion（扩张）；expansive。expand on（详述）。反义 contract / shrink。
words.phrases: expand into（扩展到）, expand on（详述）, economic expansion（经济扩张）
words.example: The university plans to expand its online courses over the next five years.（该大学计划在未来五年扩大在线课程。）
words.root: ex-（向外）+ pand（展开）→ 向外展开
words.exampleEn: The university plans to expand its online courses over the next five years.
words.exampleZh: 该大学计划在未来五年扩大在线课程。
words.mnemonic: ex-（向外）+ pand（展开）→ 向外展开
words.exampleEN: The university plans to expand its online courses over the next five years.
words.exampleCN: 该大学计划在未来五年扩大在线课程。

words.meaning: n. ①时装，时尚（fashion industry）；②方式（in a … fashion）；③流行。v. 制作，塑造。fashionable；out of fashion。after a fashion（勉强地）。
words.phrases: fashion industry（时装业）, in a timely fashion（及时地）, out of fashion（过时）
words.example: The fashion industry has been criticised for encouraging waste.（时装业因助长浪费而受到批评。）
words.root: fac（做）同源 → 做成的样式 → 时尚/方式
words.exampleEn: The fashion industry has been criticised for encouraging waste.
words.exampleZh: 时装业因助长浪费而受到批评。
words.mnemonic: fac（做）同源 → 做成的样式 → 时尚/方式
words.exampleEN: The fashion industry has been criticised for encouraging waste.
words.exampleCN: 时装业因助长浪费而受到批评。

words.meaning: n. ①数字（official figures）；②人物；③体形；④图形。v. ①认为（figure that）；②计算；③出现（figure in）。figure out（弄明白）。
words.phrases: official figures（官方数字）, public figure（公众人物）, figure out（弄明白）
words.example: Official figures show a decline in smoking among young adults.（官方数字显示，年轻成年人中的吸烟率有所下降。）
words.root: 原义‘形状’，引申为数字、人物轮廓
words.exampleEn: Official figures show a decline in smoking among young adults.
words.exampleZh: 官方数字显示，年轻成年人中的吸烟率有所下降。
words.mnemonic: 原义‘形状’，引申为数字、人物轮廓
words.exampleEN: Official figures show a decline in smoking among young adults.
words.exampleCN: 官方数字显示，年轻成年人中的吸烟率有所下降。

words.meaning: n. ①肌肉（muscle strength / pain）；②实力，力量（political muscle）。muscular（肌肉的）。pull a muscle（拉伤肌肉）。
words.phrases: muscle strength（肌肉力量）, pull a muscle（拉伤肌肉）, political muscle（政治实力）
words.example: Regular exercise increases muscle strength and improves sleep.（规律锻炼能增强肌肉力量并改善睡眠。）
words.root: 拉丁语 musculus（小老鼠）→ 肌肉滚动如鼠
words.exampleEn: Regular exercise increases muscle strength and improves sleep.
words.exampleZh: 规律锻炼能增强肌肉力量并改善睡眠。
words.mnemonic: 拉丁语 musculus（小老鼠）→ 肌肉滚动如鼠
words.exampleEN: Regular exercise increases muscle strength and improves sleep.
words.exampleCN: 规律锻炼能增强肌肉力量并改善睡眠。

words.meaning: n. ①网络（a network of）；②人际关系网；③广播网。v. 建立联系（network with）。social network；networking。
words.phrases: social network（社交网络）, a network of（…的网络）, network with（与…建立联系）
words.example: Professional networks can improve graduates' access to internships.（职业关系网可以改善毕业生获得实习的机会。）
words.root: net（网）+ work → 网状系统
words.exampleEn: Professional networks can improve graduates' access to internships.
words.exampleZh: 职业关系网可以改善毕业生获得实习的机会。
words.mnemonic: net（网）+ work → 网状系统
words.exampleEN: Professional networks can improve graduates' access to internships.
words.exampleCN: 职业关系网可以改善毕业生获得实习的机会。

words.meaning: adj. ①积极的，正面的（a positive attitude / effect）；②肯定的；③阳性的。n. 正面，优点。positively。反义 negative。
words.phrases: a positive effect（正面影响）, positive attitude（积极态度）, test positive（检测呈阳性）
words.example: The training programme had a positive effect on student confidence.（该培训项目对学生自信心产生了积极影响。）
words.root: posit（放置）+ -ive → 明确给出的 → 肯定的/积极的
words.exampleEn: The training programme had a positive effect on student confidence.
words.exampleZh: 该培训项目对学生自信心产生了积极影响。
words.mnemonic: posit（放置）+ -ive → 明确给出的 → 肯定的/积极的
words.exampleEN: The training programme had a positive effect on student confidence.
words.exampleCN: 该培训项目对学生自信心产生了积极影响。

words.meaning: n. ①范围（a range of；age range）；②一系列；③山脉。v. ①变动（range from A to B）；②涉及。within range。wide-ranging。
words.phrases: a range of（一系列）, range from A to B（从A到B不等）, age range（年龄范围）
words.example: The survey covered a wide range of academic subjects.（该调查涵盖了广泛的学科范围。）
words.root: 原义‘排成一行’→ 从一端到另一端的跨度
words.exampleEn: The survey covered a wide range of academic subjects.
words.exampleZh: 该调查涵盖了广泛的学科范围。
words.mnemonic: 原义‘排成一行’→ 从一端到另一端的跨度
words.exampleEN: The survey covered a wide range of academic subjects.
words.exampleCN: 该调查涵盖了广泛的学科范围。

words.meaning: v. ①认为，料想（I suppose that）；②假定（suppose / supposing that）。be supposed to（应该，被期望）。supposedly。assumption 勿混。
words.phrases: be supposed to（应该）, suppose that（假定…）, I suppose（我想）
words.example: Students are supposed to submit the assignment by Friday.（学生应在星期五之前提交作业。）
words.root: sup-（在下）+ pose（放置）→ 放在前提之下 → 假定
words.exampleEn: Students are supposed to submit the assignment by Friday.
words.exampleZh: 学生应在星期五之前提交作业。
words.mnemonic: sup-（在下）+ pose（放置）→ 放在前提之下 → 假定
words.exampleEN: Students are supposed to submit the assignment by Friday.
words.exampleCN: 学生应在星期五之前提交作业。

words.meaning: n. ①方法，途径（an approach to doing/sth）；②接近。v. ①接近；②着手处理。approachable。与 method 近义，approach 更强调视角。
words.phrases: an approach to（…的方法）, approach a problem（着手处理问题）, as sb approaches（当某人接近时）
words.example: A problem-based approach to teaching can improve critical thinking.（基于问题的教学方法可以提高批判性思维。）
words.root: ap-（向）+ proach（近）→ 走近 → 方法/接近
words.exampleEn: A problem-based approach to teaching can improve critical thinking.
words.exampleZh: 基于问题的教学方法可以提高批判性思维。
words.mnemonic: ap-（向）+ proach（近）→ 走近 → 方法/接近
words.exampleEN: A problem-based approach to teaching can improve critical thinking.
words.exampleCN: 基于问题的教学方法可以提高批判性思维。

words.meaning: n. 校园（on campus；university campus）。off campus（校外）。campus life。复数 campuses。
words.phrases: on campus（在校园内）, off campus（在校外）, campus life（校园生活）
words.example: New sports facilities will be built on campus next year.（明年将在校园内新建体育设施。）
words.root: 拉丁语 campus（平地、场地）→ 大学场地
words.exampleEn: New sports facilities will be built on campus next year.
words.exampleZh: 明年将在校园内新建体育设施。
words.mnemonic: 拉丁语 campus（平地、场地）→ 大学场地
words.exampleEN: New sports facilities will be built on campus next year.
words.exampleCN: 明年将在校园内新建体育设施。

words.meaning: v. 描述，描写（describe sb/sth as；describe how）。description（描述）；descriptive。beyond description。
words.phrases: describe as（把…描述为）, a detailed description（详细描述）, describe how（描述如何）
words.example: Participants were asked to describe how they prepared for examinations.（参与者被要求描述他们如何准备考试。）
words.root: de-（向下）+ scribe（写）→ 写下来 → 描述
words.exampleEn: Participants were asked to describe how they prepared for examinations.
words.exampleZh: 参与者被要求描述他们如何准备考试。
words.mnemonic: de-（向下）+ scribe（写）→ 写下来 → 描述
words.exampleEN: Participants were asked to describe how they prepared for examinations.
words.exampleCN: 参与者被要求描述他们如何准备考试。

words.meaning: n. ①事件（a historical event）；②活动，赛事（a sporting event）；③结果（in the event of 如果发生）。eventual（最终的）；eventually。
words.phrases: in the event of（如果发生）, sporting event（体育赛事）, a major event（重大事件）
words.example: The conference is the most important academic event of the year.（该会议是本年度最重要的学术活动。）
words.root: e-（出）+ vent（来）→ 发生出来的事
words.exampleEn: The conference is the most important academic event of the year.
words.exampleZh: 该会议是本年度最重要的学术活动。
words.mnemonic: e-（出）+ vent（来）→ 发生出来的事
words.exampleEN: The conference is the most important academic event of the year.
words.exampleCN: 该会议是本年度最重要的学术活动。

words.meaning: n. ①气候（climate change）；②风气，氛围（a climate of fear / economic climate）。climatic。与 weather（天气，短时）区分。
words.phrases: climate change（气候变化）, economic climate（经济气候）, a climate of（…的氛围）
words.example: Climate change poses a serious challenge to food production.（气候变化对粮食生产构成严峻挑战。）
words.root: clima（倾斜/地带）→ 地带的长期天气 → 气候
words.exampleEn: Climate change poses a serious challenge to food production.
words.exampleZh: 气候变化对粮食生产构成严峻挑战。
words.mnemonic: clima（倾斜/地带）→ 地带的长期天气 → 气候
words.exampleEN: Climate change poses a serious challenge to food production.
words.exampleCN: 气候变化对粮食生产构成严峻挑战。

words.meaning: adv. ①最后，终于（finally, …；it finally became clear that）；②最终。final（最后的；决赛）。at last 更口语、带感情色彩。
words.phrases: finally decide（最终决定）, the final report（最终报告）, at the final stage（在最后阶段）
words.example: The committee finally approved the new assessment policy.（委员会最终批准了新的评估政策。）
words.root: final（最后的）+ -ly
words.exampleEn: The committee finally approved the new assessment policy.
words.exampleZh: 委员会最终批准了新的评估政策。
words.mnemonic: final（最后的）+ -ly
words.exampleEN: The committee finally approved the new assessment policy.
words.exampleCN: 委员会最终批准了新的评估政策。

words.meaning: n. 塑料（plastic waste；不可数总称，也可说 plastics）。adj. ①塑料的；②可塑的。plastic bag / pollution。plasticity（可塑性）。
words.phrases: plastic waste（塑料垃圾）, plastic bag（塑料袋）, plastic pollution（塑料污染）
words.example: Many cities have restricted the use of single-use plastic bags.（许多城市已限制一次性塑料袋的使用。）
words.root: plast（塑造）+ -ic → 可塑造的材料
words.exampleEn: Many cities have restricted the use of single-use plastic bags.
words.exampleZh: 许多城市已限制一次性塑料袋的使用。
words.mnemonic: plast（塑造）+ -ic → 可塑造的材料
words.exampleEN: Many cities have restricted the use of single-use plastic bags.
words.exampleCN: 许多城市已限制一次性塑料袋的使用。

words.meaning: adj. 有创造力的，创造性的（creative thinking / writing）。creativity（创造力）；create；creation。creative industries（创意产业）。
words.phrases: creative thinking（创造性思维）, creative writing（创意写作）, creative industries（创意产业）
words.example: The course aims to develop students' creative thinking skills.（该课程旨在培养学生的创造性思维能力。）
words.root: create（创造）+ -ive → 能创造的
words.exampleEn: The course aims to develop students' creative thinking skills.
words.exampleZh: 该课程旨在培养学生的创造性思维能力。
words.mnemonic: create（创造）+ -ive → 能创造的
words.exampleEN: The course aims to develop students' creative thinking skills.
words.exampleCN: 该课程旨在培养学生的创造性思维能力。

words.meaning: adj. 额外的（extra time / cost）。adv. 额外地。n. 额外的事物（the extras）。extra-curricular（课外的）。
words.phrases: extra time（额外时间）, extra cost（额外费用）, extra-curricular activities（课外活动）
words.example: Students may need extra time to complete laboratory reports.（学生可能需要额外时间来完成实验报告。）
words.root: extra-（在外）→ 在规定之外的
words.exampleEn: Students may need extra time to complete laboratory reports.
words.exampleZh: 学生可能需要额外时间来完成实验报告。
words.mnemonic: extra-（在外）→ 在规定之外的
words.exampleEN: Students may need extra time to complete laboratory reports.
words.exampleCN: 学生可能需要额外时间来完成实验报告。

words.meaning: n. 贫穷，贫困（live in poverty；poverty line）。poor（贫穷的）；impoverished。anti-poverty policy。反义 wealth。
words.phrases: in poverty（处于贫困中）, poverty line（贫困线）, reduce poverty（减少贫困）
words.example: Education is often seen as an effective way to reduce poverty.（教育常被视为减少贫困的有效途径。）
words.root: poor（穷）的名词形式，-ty 表状态
words.exampleEn: Education is often seen as an effective way to reduce poverty.
words.exampleZh: 教育常被视为减少贫困的有效途径。
words.mnemonic: poor（穷）的名词形式，-ty 表状态
words.exampleEN: Education is often seen as an effective way to reduce poverty.
words.exampleCN: 教育常被视为减少贫困的有效途径。

words.meaning: v. ①释放，放走；②发布（release a report）；③发行。n. 释放，发布。press release（新闻稿）。release from。
words.phrases: release a report（发布报告）, press release（新闻稿）, release from（从…中解脱）
words.example: The government released a report on air quality last month.（政府上个月发布了一份关于空气质量的报告。）
words.root: re-（回）+ lease（松开）→ 放开
words.exampleEn: The government released a report on air quality last month.
words.exampleZh: 政府上个月发布了一份关于空气质量的报告。
words.mnemonic: re-（回）+ lease（松开）→ 放开
words.exampleEN: The government released a report on air quality last month.
words.exampleCN: 政府上个月发布了一份关于空气质量的报告。

words.meaning: n. ①解决办法（a solution to，不接 of）；②溶液。solve（解决）。find / propose a solution。solution to the problem。
words.phrases: a solution to（…的解决办法）, find a solution（找到解决办法）, chemical solution（化学溶液）
words.example: There is no simple solution to the shortage of affordable housing.（住房负担能力不足的问题没有简单的解决办法。）
words.root: solve（解决）+ -tion → 解决的结果
words.exampleEn: There is no simple solution to the shortage of affordable housing.
words.exampleZh: 住房负担能力不足的问题没有简单的解决办法。
words.mnemonic: solve（解决）+ -tion → 解决的结果
words.exampleEN: There is no simple solution to the shortage of affordable housing.
words.exampleCN: 住房负担能力不足的问题没有简单的解决办法。

words.meaning: n. 租金（pay rent；high rent）。v. 租用，出租（rent a flat；rent out）。rental。for rent。英式住房常用 flat，与 apartment 近义。
words.phrases: pay rent（付租金）, rent a flat（租一套公寓）, for rent（待租）
words.example: Rising rent has increased the cost of living for university students.（不断上涨的租金提高了大学生的生活成本。）
words.root: 原义‘付给的钱’→ 房租/租用
words.exampleEn: Rising rent has increased the cost of living for university students.
words.exampleZh: 不断上涨的租金提高了大学生的生活成本。
words.mnemonic: 原义‘付给的钱’→ 房租/租用
words.exampleEN: Rising rent has increased the cost of living for university students.
words.exampleCN: 不断上涨的租金提高了大学生的生活成本。

words.meaning: n. 预算（the education budget；on a tight budget）。v. 把…编入预算。budget for。budget cut。
words.phrases: on a tight budget（预算紧张）, education budget（教育预算）, budget cut（预算削减）
words.example: Many students have to live on a tight budget during term time.（许多学生在学期期间不得不精打细算。）
words.root: 原指钱袋，引申为袋子里能花的钱 → 预算
words.exampleEn: Many students have to live on a tight budget during term time.
words.exampleZh: 许多学生在学期期间不得不精打细算。
words.mnemonic: 原指钱袋，引申为袋子里能花的钱 → 预算
words.exampleEN: Many students have to live on a tight budget during term time.
words.exampleCN: 许多学生在学期期间不得不精打细算。
